prompt_v1: Label this support ticket as exactly one of: billing, bug, refund, other. Answer with the label only.
prompt_v2: Label this support ticket as exactly one of: billing, bug, refund, other. Answer with the label only. A request to reverse, correct or explain a charge is billing. Use refund only when the customer asks for money back for something they bought or cancelled. Example: 'I was charged twice, please reverse one' is billing.
temperature: simulated as 0: the same text always gets the same label
how: make_data.py draws one random number per (seed, text) and maps it through each version's chances for that wording template, so the two versions only disagree where v2 changed the chances.
gold_label_source: simulated single human labeller, treated as the truth
